objective: Make local AI code review coverage and evidence claims machine-checkable for dirty candidate worktrees without changing robot behavior.
in_scope: Generate a trusted-base review inventory for committed and uncommitted changes
Keep both old and new paths visible when a file is renamed
Include index-only staged changes and reject evidence when staged and tested bytes diverge
Bind review evidence to the reviewed base, head, and ChangeContract
Validate review coverage, findings status, and referenced execution evidence
Route an AGENTS.md-aware coding Agent through the new local review gate
out_of_scope: Automatic commits, pushes, merges, or server-side policy changes
Claiming model review or human approval from a JSON record
invariants: The simulated SafetyGate and physical-output state remain unchanged.
Skipped, missing, failed, or stale checks are never represented as passing review evidence.
A candidate-authored record cannot grant independent human approval.
stop_conditions: The review inventory omits any tracked, dirty, or untracked changed path.
A review claims completion with unreviewed files, unresolved findings, or invalid evidence.
A change would alter robot safety authority or require real hardware.
